_comment: Label-not-bury: the stale decision (ref missing from the app graph) must stay reachable in top-3 WITH a [stale:] label instead of being buried by the -18 penalty. Baseline fails recall_at_3 and the output assertion; passes after Phase 1.3 (graduated penalty + labels) and Phase 1.5 (multi-evidence recall output).

items.subject: auth login flow
items.text: Decision: keep the login flow in src/auth/login.ts with session cookies issued from src/auth/session.ts.

items.subject: auth login legacy
items.text: Decision: the legacy login handler lived in src/legacy/login-old.ts before the auth move; kept for context on why redirects double-encode.

items.subject: auth login throttling
items.text: Insight: login throttling in src/auth/rate-limit.ts counts per account, not per ip, so shared-office logins do not trip it.
Command (test): npm test -- auth login session (exit 0)
